assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The symptoms are concerning for underlying arrhythmia
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The condition is coded as I34.0
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
A long-term continuous ECG monitoring study is indicated
The monitoring study is coded as CPT 93247
The study is intended to correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances
The study evaluates for potential atrial fibrillation or other dysrhythmias
The indication is documented in the clinical indication
The service addresses the diagnosed condition and need to identify intermittent rhythm disturbances
